facts.one_line_description: Provides integrated oncology management solutions combining utilization management, supportive care, and data analytics for health plans and employers.
products_services: Oncology Management (utilization management, prior authorization, clinical pathways)
Oncology Supportive Care (24/7 oncology nursing, mental health, nutrition, resource navigation via Iris platform)
stated_value_props: Purpose-built oncology platform that delivers measurable savings without compromising care
Proactive member engagement with whole-person supportive care
Reduced physical, mental, and financial toll of cancer
Industry's first integrated oncology management solution
recent_themes: Supportive care as core oncology infrastructure
Unmet needs in cancer patient support (73% without mental health access, 66% without nurse line, 65% without nutritional support)
facts.tone_signals: Professional, clinical, compassionate, patient-centric. Core values emphasize "patient first," "customer delight," "innovation focus," and "clinical excellence." Mission-driven language focused on reducing burden of cancer.

icp.icp_reasoning: Total 76 → Tier B. Industry 13/30. Scale 25/25. Network 24/25. Growth 7/10. Readiness 7/10.

industry_fit.rationale: [ADJACENT_HEALTHCARE] OncoHealth provides oncology management solutions including utilization management, prior authorization, clinical pathways, and care coordination for health plans and employers. While deeply healthcare-focused, they are not themselves a health plan, digital health provider delivery platform, or staffing/network operator—they provide UM/care management services as a vendor to health plans.

scale_signals.rationale: [OVER_1M, enterprise customers] 15 million members supported, 22 health plan partners, 4,000 employer partners, $240M delivered in customer savings in 2024. Clear enterprise customer base (health plans) though specific names not mentioned.

provider_network_signal.rationale: [RUNS_MULTI_STATE_NETWORK] Operates a '50-state virtual medical group for oncology' which indicates they run a multi-state provider network for oncology services.

growth_maturity.rationale: [ACTIVE_GROWTH] Strong customer metrics with 22 health plan partners, 4,000 employer partners, 15M members, and $240M in customer savings in 2024. High satisfaction scores (94% provider, 92 NPS) suggest momentum. Recent themes around 2026 drug approvals indicate forward planning. No explicit funding or rapid hiring signals, but scale and metrics suggest active growth.

buying_readiness.rationale: [STRONG_THEMES] Operating a 50-state virtual medical group strongly implies multi-state provider licensing and credentialing needs. Recent themes around supportive care infrastructure, provider relationships, and scaling oncology services across 22 health plans and 50 states indicate ongoing provider operations and network management challenges.

intent_themes.theme: Multi-state provider licensing for 50-state virtual oncology network
Provider credentialing and enrollment for oncology specialists across health plan partnerships
Network management and monitoring for oncology provider relationships across 22 health plan partners

pain_points.pain: Managing provider licensing and credentialing across 50 states for virtual oncology medical group
pain_points.evidence: Operates '50-state virtual medical group for oncology' which requires maintaining licenses and credentials for providers across all states

pain_points.pain: Scaling provider network operations while maintaining 94% provider satisfaction across expanding health plan partnerships
pain_points.evidence: 22 health plan partners with 15M members and 94% provider satisfaction suggests need for efficient provider operations at scale

pain_points.pain: Provider enrollment and network adequacy management across multiple health plan contracts
pain_points.evidence: Serving 22 health plan partners requires managing provider enrollment and ensuring adequate oncology network coverage for each plan's requirements

copy.hero_headline: Provider licensing across 50 states shouldn't slow your oncology network
copy.subheadline: OncoHealth manages oncology care for 15M members and 22 health plans. CertifyOS keeps your virtual medical group credentialed, compliant, and ready to scale.
copy.value_prop_one_liner: A single platform to manage multi-state licensing, health plan enrollment, and credential monitoring for your oncology specialists.
copy.pain_paragraph: Running a 50-state virtual medical group means constant credential renewals, varying state license requirements, and enrollment backlogs across 22 health plan contracts. Manual tracking breaks down at scale. Providers wait. Plans push for network adequacy. Your team juggles spreadsheets while trying to maintain 94% provider satisfaction.

cta_primary.text: See how it works for oncology networks
